title: Dealer-Gamma Feedback and Local Volatility Cycles: A Fixed-Equilibrium Bifurcation Model and a Pre-Extraction Identification Protocol
description: Software, manuscript source, and reproducibility materials for a local physical-measure model of detrended log price, square-root variance, and filtered price memory. The centered dealer-book functional fixes the reference equilibrium while coupling varies, and variance feedback is proportional to variance so the added drift points inward at zero. The repository derives the complete cubic Routh--Hurwitz conditions, an exact eigenvalue-crossing derivative, and the first Lyapunov coefficient for a centered Gaussian signed-position book. A deliberately constructed, non-calibrated configuration has a first local Hopf point at kappa*=31.4932976/yr, omega*=47.1185670 rad/yr, and ell_1=-6.2888041; the quadratic also has a disclosed remote re-stabilizing root. The actual nonlinear drift produces a nearby positive-variance cycle, and six close amplitudes recover the Hopf square-root law. Gross-normalized signed mixtures show that the local root and supercriticality are book-dependent. These are local deterministic results, not an SPX calibration or stochastic-bifurcation result. Public open interest does not identify signed dealer inventory. Pre-extraction Amendments A13--A15 therefore register a registered-horizon, sign-agnostic proxy analysis whose conclusions are limited to predictive association. No registered market dataset is analysed in v0.4.0.
notes: Version 0.4.0 contains no registered market dataset. Add the real arXiv related identifier only after arXiv assigns it; do not publish a placeholder identifier.
